sentences.text: JUDGMENT

This is a charge sheet filed by the PSI of Magadi Road police Station, Bengaluru against the accused for the offences punishable U/sec.51 & 63 of Copy Right Act and Sec.420 of IPC.
02.

The brief facts of the prosecution case is that, on 12.01.2019 at about 6 pm within the limits of Magadi Road Police Station situated at No.108/1, Mangal Plastic Udyog, 1 st Floor, 3rd Main Road,
Rajajinagar Industrial Town, Bengaluru, the accused was manufacturing of spurious / counterfeit buttons of reputed companies i.e., Allen Solly, Van Heusen and Louis Philippe of CW.1's company without obtaining any permission from the reputed companies and were selling the duplicate buttons to the public and cheated to the CW.1 and public at large and thus the accused has committed the above said offences.
03.
After filing of charge sheet, this court took cognizance for the offences punishable U/sec.51 & 63 of Copy Right Act and Sec.420 of IPC and issued summons to the accused.
Accordingly the accused appeared before the court through his counsel and enlarged on bail.

Later on, charge sheet copies and prosecution papers were furnished to the accused under Sec.207 of Cr.P.C.
04.
Heard both side on framing of charge, perused the prosecution papers.
As there are sufficient materials to frame the charge against the accused, the charges has been framed and the same were read over to him, but he denied the contents of charge and claimed for trial.
Hence the case was posted for prosecution evidence.
05. In furtherance of the charges leveled against the accused, the following points are arisen for my consideration.
POINTS 01.

Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable doubt that, on 12.01.2019 at about 6 pm within the limits of Magadi Road Police Station situated at No.108/1, Mangal Plastic Udyog, 1st Floor, 3rd Main Road, Rajajinagar Industrial Town, Bengaluru, the accused was manufacturing of spurious / counterfeit buttons of reputed companies i.e., Allen Solly, Van Heusen and Louis Philippe of CW.1 without obtaining any permission from the reputed companies and were selling the duplicate buttons to the public and cheated to the CW.1 and public at large and thereby the accused has committed the offences punishable U/sec. 51 & 63 of Copy Right Act and Sec.420 of IPC?
2. What order or sentence?
06.

To prove the case, the prosecution has examined in all 4 witnesses i.e., CW.5, 4, 1 & 2 as PW.1 to Raghu vs Gowtham Chand on 8 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110791733/
2 4 and got marked 13 documents as Ex.P.1 to Ex.P.13 and also buttons are marked as MO.1 & 2.
The evidence of CW.3 is given-up.
07. After completion of evidence of prosecution, the incriminating circumstances in the evidence of the prosecution is read over to the accused and statement under section 313 of Cr.P.C. recorded.

The accused has denied the incriminating circumstances as false and not chosen to lead his evidence and the contents of complaint is marked as Ex.D.1 as confront document during the cross examination of of PW.3.
08.
Heard the arguments.

My findings on the above said points are as follows:-
Point No.1 : In the negative.
Point No.2: As per final order, for the following:
REASONS 09. Points No.1:
To prove the case, the prosecution has examined four witnesses.

All the witnesses supported the case by deposing that, on 12.09.2019 at 3.15 pm., the accused stored 25 packets of Allen Solly and 25 packets of Louis Philippe each containing 500 buttons in 3rd room of Mangal Plastic Udyog, situated at 1st Floor, 3rd Main Road, Rajajinagar Industrial Town, Bengaluru.
PW.1 along with PW.2 to 4 visited the spot and seized the said spurious / counterfeited buttons and conducted the mahazar in the presence of panchas.
Thereby, PW.1 to 4 have supported the case of prosecution.

But, after careful perusal of Ex.P.1 wherein it is mentioned that;
"..... Manufacturing Unit address:
MANGAL PLASTIC UDYOG, # 108/ 13, 3rd Main, Industrial Town, Rajajinagar,
Bengaluru- 560 044.

"
Further, after careful perusal of Ex.P.2 i.e., FIR in column No.6 also "# 108/ 13, 3rd Main, Industrial Town, Rajajinagar, Bengaluru- 560 044."
But, in Ex.P.3 i.e., panchanama the building number is mentioned as 108/1, which creates doubt about the place of goods stored and place of panchanama.
Further, create doubt about the case of prosecution as the address of the accused shop / premises is different and the address mentioned in the Ex.P.1 & Ex.P.2 is different.
Hence, the said address is confront marked as Ex.D.1 in Ex.P.1 during the cross examination of PW.3.

For which, PW.3 who being the complainant examined as CW.1 as himself admitted in his cross examination that, " ....

     
    
 
  
 



 
 

 

  .108/13, 3        
,

 


 

 
   


,  
 
 

 , 



     


  



 
 
 
    
   
.
 .. 1   2   

  

 



 
 

 

 
 
  
 

     

  


   
   
 ....".
10.

Further, after careful perusal of Ex.P.6, which is the Power of Attorney executed by Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Limited, Rep by Mrs. Jyothi V.K. Head- legal in favour of one Sri. M.V. Suresh Raghu vs Gowtham Chand on 8 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110791733/
3 Babu, S/o M.S. Venkataramaiah, to look after the company affairs with respect to infringement of brand name, trade mark, copy right etc., But, who in turn executed Ex.P.5 i.e., Limited Power of Attorney in favour of CW.1/ PW.3 and about the said limited Power of Attorney, the said PW.3 not at all mentioned any where in Ex.P.1, which also creates doubt about the case of prosecution and prima-facie shows about the preplan and predetermination to lodge a complaint against the accused.

entities.text: Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Limited
entities.label: ORG

entities.text: M.V. Suresh Raghu vs Gowtham Chand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Further, PW.2 who was present at the time of conducting mahazar, but he has not put his signature on Ex.P.3.
Further, no stamp duty was paid on Ex.P.5.

Further, the CW.1 in his complaint has stated that, the management of M/s.Mangal Plastic Udyog is involved in manufacture and selling of duplicate engraved buttons used for ready made garments, but in his cross examination has admitted that " 

   
  
  

   
 
     

   
   
 
 

  
 
 



 

....." which clearly reveals that, there were no instrument to manufacture the said buttons at the spot, which also clearly creates doubt about the case of prosecution.
Therefore, the benefit of doubt in the case of the prosecution is to be extended to the accused.
Therefore, by extending the benefit of doubt in the case of the prosecution to the accused, this court answers the above Points No.1 in the Negative.
11. Point No.3:-

In view of the findings recorded to the above points, this court proceed to pass the following:
ORDER
By exercising powers conferred U/sec. 248(1) of Cr.P.C., the accused is acquitted of the offences punishable U/Sec. 51 & 63 of Copy Right Act and sec. 420 of IPC.
The bail bond and surety bond of the accused shall continue in force for a period of 6 months.
The accused is set at liberty.
The property reported in PF No.02/2019 marked as MO.1 & 2 being buttons are ordered to be destroyed as worthless after appeal period is over.
(Dictated to the Stenographer directly on computer and print out taken by her is verified and then pronounced by me in the open court on this the 8th day of October 2024.)
(Sri. Vinod Balnaik.)
IX Addl.Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bengaluru City.
